title: Add new options to generate workspace

timeline.message:
Add new options to generate workspace

These two new options, `--build_file` and `--workspace_file` allow users
of the generate workspace tool to specify a custom destination for the
generated `BUILD` and `WORKSPACE` files. These new options are
incompatible with the current `--output_dir` option.

Fixes bazelbuild/bazel#1520.
timeline.author: Mickey Reiss

timeline.body:
I ran into the same issue that @pgr0ss noticed while integrating the generate workspace tool into my workflow. So, without much context, I attempted to solve #1520. 

This is my first foray into bazel's codebase, so I welcome feedback on my code. I think the option handling code could be improved with a refactor at this point or in the future.

cc/ @kchodorow
Can one of the admins verify this patch?
Thanks for your contribution, @kchodorow will review it, please do not hesitate to ping if you haven't heard from us in the next 2 business days!
Also from a quick look this is safe so Mr Jenkins: test this please.
Your else's content is the same as the if's.
Use positive conditions when possible (e.g., if reqOutputDir.isEmpty()) as it's more readable, especially since requestBuildOutputDir is non-empty if-and-only-if reqWorkspaceOutputDir is non-empty.
Wait, do you want people to be able to specify --output_dir and one of --build_file or --workspace_file?

The possibilities are:
1. `workspace_file` and `build_file` (new behavior, requested in #1520)
2. `output_dir` (current behavior)
Thanks for the review! I'll make some changes and try to address the build failures.

With the current logic, `generate_workspace --workspace_file=whatever --output_dir=whatever` wouldn't throw an error (`options.buildOutputFile.isEmpty() && options.workspaceOutputFile.isEmpty()) != options.outputDir.isEmpty()` -> `(true && false) != false` -> `false != false`.
Might as well add to https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/blob/master/site/docs/external.md now.
I don't think the ci.bazel.io failure was your commit, it looks like it cannot find grpc's exe for some reason.

This is because of the baseline, rebasing should fix it.
